angleEvidenceBrief: The same stretch of quay in 1994, 2010 and 2025: boats moored three deep at the start, empty berths and no crane at the end. The evidence is the three photographs themselves; nothing is computed, and G1 grounded the takeaway as unverifiable because the frozen table is a photograph manifest carrying no quantity. Two of the three photographs have no photographer and print "Source: not stated"; the 2010 frame has no surviving caption and carries the desk own sentence about that absence instead of an invented description.
reviewer: desk (stress round five, journalist decision taken by the producer)
